swing_seax.use: the seax's swing, the moment the blow starts

swing.use: the sword's swing; also fists and the men's swings

swing_greataxe.use: the Dane axe's swing, slow and heavy

hit_seax.use: the seax on flesh or hide

hit.use: the sword on flesh or hide

hit_spear.use: the spear on flesh or hide

hit_axe.use: the axe on flesh or hide

hit_club.use: the club on flesh or hide

hit_greataxe.use: the Dane axe on flesh or hide

heavyhit.use: the chain's last blow with the sword (also the seax's and the spear's)

heavyhit_club.use: every club hit that counts as heavy

heavyhit_greataxe.use: every Dane axe hit that counts as heavy

block.use: a blow stopped on the wooden round shield

parry.use: the timed deflect, metal on metal

crit.use: an accent laid over a hit

chain_2.use: laid over parry when the parries run x2

chain_3.use: laid over parry when the parries run x3

chain_4.use: laid over parry when the parries run x4 (the peak)

finish.use: the finishing blow (time slows): the biggest impact

heavytell.use: an unparriable blow winding up (the red glint)

perfect.use: a dash in the last moment (time slows)

slam.use: a guard broken, a heavy landing

die.use: a man or a beast falls

tele.use: a man begins a blow that can be parried

swing_a.use: sword swing candidate A: recorded whooshes only

swing_b.use: sword swing candidate B: the body (arm, cloth, leather)

swing_c.use: sword swing candidate C: only a breath before the impact

swing_d.use: sword swing candidate D: a mirrored pass

swish_seax.use: the seax's swing (from Robin's pick E): dB relative to E

swish_spear.use: the spear's thrust (from E): dB relative to E

swish_axe.use: the axe's swing (from E and F): dB relative to E

swish_club.use: the club's swing (from F): dB relative to E

swish_greataxe.use: the Dane axe's swing (from F and E): dB relative to E
